Started out as a challenge by {{player|bps|flag=se}}, to build a christmas themed dmm4 map in three hours. In exploring architecture, lighting and textures {{player|lurq|flag=se}} missed the three hour mark but had it done in three days. 

The map is heavily inspired by a real hotel (which name is now forgotten) and the Overlook hotel from [https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Shining_(film) The Shining].

Beyond dmm4, it includes a secret single player mission...
